pages.text: Hold any BHB weapon in your off hand and $(k:use) to attack with it. The off hand has its own cooldown, based on that weapon's speed, so you can alternate hands for a quicker rhythm. Its cooldown shows as a second bar under the main hand's, below the crosshair.$(br2)Off-hand hits deal 85% of the weapon's damage, roll heavy and light swings, can crit, and build pressure like any other hit.

Any pairing works: two of a kind, two different weapons, even a two-handed weapon with something in the other hand. A two-handed weapon gives up its empty-off-hand damage bonus while you do. Shields stay shields.$(br2)A Glare Strike can be thrown with whichever hand is ready.
